_help: Election-night fallback. If a state feed breaks, edit this file in the GitHub web UI (works from a phone). Any race listed here REPLACES the scraped data for that race on the next run. Set 'called' to 'REP' or 'DEM' when a network/AP calls the race. Delete the race entry (or set enabled=false) to go back to the automatic feed.
_help_calls: 'calls' marks a race as called by AP/networks WITHOUT touching the vote feed: {"SEN-GA": "DEM"}. Remove the entry to un-call.
